scope: Emmy Noether Paper 16, Zur Reihenentwicklung in der Formentheorie, Mathematische Annalen 81 (1920), pp. 25-30; corrected-source-route audit against the current R259 German base after WebR252.
result: No TeX patch promoted. The package verifies that the current R259 P16 span already represents the inspected formula-heavy loci and records an invalid older source-route trap.
invalid_source_route_trap: Earlier P16-labelled GDZ canvases 00000025 through 00000030 are invalid for P16 and must not be used. The valid practical witnesses are IA Math. Ann. 81 leaves 0028-0033 / GDZ PPN235181684_0081 canvases 00000031-00000036, also included as a GDZ PDF slice pages 32-37.
checked_loci: printed p25: title, subtitle, author, opening prose, footnote 1
printed p27: formulas [2]-[3] and normal-form problem paragraph
printed p28: correction paragraph, section 1 opening, formulas [4], [5], [6], [2a], footnote 5
printed p29: formulas [7], [8], [9], iteration chain, footnotes 6-7, general n-row specialization
printed p30: formula [10], section 2 specialization, Berichtigungen, acceptance line
source_quality: Not strict native 650+ ppi certification. GDZ page images are 400 ppi; IA PNG witnesses are approximately 2265/2288 by 3340 pixels with unhelpful 96 dpi metadata. Included crop PNGs are enlarged labelled inspection witnesses, not new native high-resolution source.
public_policy: Treat as source-route/source-audit/no-patch support material, not as a reader release.
Do not call this Paper 16 certification, whole-Noether certification, source closure, multilingual synchronization, or a critical edition.
Use the package to prevent stale source-route regressions and false edits, especially the p29 iteration-chain no-fix trap.
